title: Egyptian Civil Code — Article ٢
text:
وإذا عاد شخص توافرت فيه الأهلية بحسب نصوص قديمة ناقص
الأهلية بحسب نصوص جديدة فإن ذلك لا يؤثر في تصرفاته السابقة.

--- English Translation ---

When a person, who was deemed to possess legal
capacity in accordance with the provisions of a former
law, becomes legally incapable in accordance with the
provisions of a new law, such legal incapacity does not
affect the validity of acts previously done by him.
